*Aditya Dhar* is now one of my favourite directors of all-time 🗿
His stories often have an emotional core, the characters are well written (personal struggle, emotional conflicts, etc), the structural narrative style, he embraced patriotism without making it jingoistic, he is a prodigy in technicalities, his storytelling is ambitious and he is a Pro-Nationalist but not an Anti-Muslim filmmaker 🥹

snippet.textDisplay:
I'm from karnataka 
But dhurandhar ate toxic
I'm happy and sad at the same time😅....

Thats y they say story places itself above all❤
Stardom might give u opening numbers like toxic had its 150 cr worldwide only bcz of yash 
But surviving after that matters most.... if toxic didnt had those confusing and unnecessary adult scenes then ppl would have loved that too....😢
Overall toxic had a good idea concept on paper but went horrible with execution.....and that's where ppl like prashant neel aditya dhar rajamouli stand out and are in their own league....
Yash will have his comeback in Ramayana ofc But one thing he can learn from another superstars like ranvir singh ranbir kapoor is to be a director's actor and not interfere with script screenplay etc just bcz u r a producer or just bcz u have massive following both online and offline🙂🙂🙂👍

snippet.textDisplay:
Dhurandhar: The Revenge (2026) is a high-octane Indian Hindi-language spy action-thriller written and directed by Aditya Dhar. Serving as the sequel to the 2025 hit Dhurandhar, the film continues the gripping narrative of Jaskirat Singh Rangi (played by Ranveer Singh), who undergoes a transformation to become the operative Hamza Ali Mazari.

Plot Highlights:
Undercover Mission: Jaskirat infiltrates deep into enemy territory to dismantle networks of terrorism and corruption targeting India (1:35 - 1:46).
High Stakes: As the film unfolds, he faces dangerous adversaries and ruthless figures like Major Iqbal, escalating the conflict between power and national security (1:38 - 1:46).
The Promise: The film centers on the premise that the future of Pakistan will be determined by Hindustan, marking a shift in the balance of power (2:45 - 2:48).

Production Details:
Release Date: The movie hit theaters worldwide on March 19, 2026.
Production: Produced by Aditya Dhar, Lokesh Dhar, and Jyoti Deshpande under Jio Studios and B62 Studios.
Soundtrack: The trailer features intense music and a background score by Shashwat Sachdev, including the track "Ari Ari."

snippet.textDisplay: Is movie mein Pinda pe Sabse zyada gussa aata hai. I felt pinda to be the real monster. Major Iqbal toh still traumatized tha although he was evil but atleast he was kind to his daughter and loved his wife. Pinda on the other hand was inherently evil. He betrayed Jasikirat his buddy, Jasleen, india. Such a disgusting character he was. Jasikirat should have killed pinda in the first scene itself. I atleast felt bad for Iqbal how his father mistreated him but for pinda, i would have killed him. Jassi bhai bohot acha hai. He didn't betray alam , yalina nor betrayed india. Despite every single one betrayed him including indian government too who to be honest exploited his innocence to the best. Why can't that Ajay Sanyal sent that mp sukhvinder singh to pakistan and do the job. Unke liye sanyal sab chat raha tha aur Jasikirat ke saamne nautanki karta hai sher sher bolke. Jasikirat sher hai Sanyal giddar hai. Sab giddar tha flim mein but gussa uthta hai Sanyal ki notanki dekhke. Justice dila payega Jasikirat ko. Kitni acha hai Jasikirat.  Love you jassi Bhai you're great 😢❤

snippet.textDisplay:
If Durander 2 is viewed through a political lens, the film builds a dangerous narrative. The villain, Gajraj, is politically accurate because he represents the kind of real-life criminal-politician strongman often seen in society. However, the real problem lies in the portrayal of the hero, Durander, and the police officer, Jagga.

The police are written in a politically unrealistic and problematic way because they abandon their institutional responsibility and effectively tell the hero, “You do it yourself.” This goes completely against how real governance and constitutional systems are supposed to function. At the same time, the hero is portrayed as an over-the-top vigilante who delivers justice on his own, which in a democracy promotes chaos and anarchy rather than lawful order.

The film’s overall message — “the system is broken, so take justice into your own hands” — is not a realistic solution. Instead, it indirectly promotes an authoritarian mindset. In the end, the villain feels believable, but the portrayal of the hero and the police is politically misleading and problematic.

snippet.textDisplay:
Let’s call it out: these films simplify, distort, and politicize.
In Uri: The Surgical Strike, the National Security Advisor is shown like a field commander. That’s factually wrong. The Army answers through its own hierarchy led by the Chief of the Army Staff.
Then you have a Major casually bypassing the entire chain of command—something that would never fly in a professional military.
And now, with Dhurandhar 2, the pattern seems worse: real-world events appear to be rewritten into hero-centric encounters, even when widely reported accounts suggest otherwise (like drone-based eliminations).
Add to that the heavy political tone, and it stops feeling like cinema—it starts looking like messaging.

This film is a fake love letter from the deceptive Indian Bollywood industry to the Balochistan community. This is Bollywood patronising the struggles of real victims for entertainment and profit.
Utterly distasteful and disgusting.
This is a fantasy of what India would like to do but in reality lacks the intelligence to do. The Indians would love to be as deceptive as their role models MOSSAD but are stuck on the scam call centre level of espionage. They can only pretend to be macho through fiction which is desperate and pathetic. Everything for these people is a never-ending tedious urinating contest. They regurgitate the same narrative because they can only live life as a broken record and refuse to move forward.
Pakistan lives rent free in their minds 24/7. They are obsessed and the more Pakistan ignores these deluded fragile egos, the louder and bigger the budget becomes. But this will only serve to entertain for a short period and as soon as the people leave the cinema the problems are still waiting for them at home. The same questions are asked, why does GDP growth not resulted in employment? Why are the rich becoming richer and poverty is still rising? What happened to the promises of industrialisation? Why are the rich allowed to exploit loopholes with impunity? Why has the government not done anything about 30,000+ applicants for only10 government vacancies?
People like Arnab Goswami and Bollywood propaganda are just the distraction to create the fake boogie man so everyone is preoccupied to ask the real questions and hold those in-charge accountable.

snippet.textDisplay:
Dhurandhar dekhne ke baad jab ye trailer dekha tha tab laga tha is film me to Akshay Khanna bhi nahi hai, kya hi hoga isme bas Ranveer Singh ki back story hogi, aur Major Iqbaal se fight hogi jyada se jyada bas aur kya hi hoga.
Aur ab ye film theatre me dekhne ke baad ab lag raha hai First wali Dhurandhar me to kuch bhi nahi tha, bas thoda sa action aur thrill tha - lekin isme to Khatarnak action, thrill, aur music bhi ek number. 'Destiny' wala song jab interval ke baad aata hai wo abhi tak dimaag me hai.
Aisa lagta hai itni lambi film fursat se banayi hai kayi saal me, tab jaa kar bani hai Dhurandhar. Part 1 aur 2 dono alag alag mood ki film lagti hai - lekin 1st Dhurandhar ka 'First Look' video aur 'Trailer' dekho to usme dono part ke scenes hai us se lagta hai ki ye puri 7-8 ghante ki ek hi film hai - means chapter 'Et tu brutus' ke baad 'burnt memory' aata hai jo is film ka 1st chapter hai.
Bas is wali part ka music hi aisa epic hai ki ek next level vibe aati hai. 1st wali dhurandhar ka music thoda stable hai to wahan fun aur heroic vibe aati hai jaise title track jisme 'goat of 'em all' bolte hain, aur romantic song, party song sab ek badhiya happy aur high vibe dete hain  - Lekin is part ka music thoda vulnerable side me hai - ranveer singh ka past aur present dono par ek tragedy ki tarah sunayi deta hai, jaise 'jaan se guzarte hain' , 'jaiye sajna', 'aari aari' (ye thoda revenge wali vibe deta hai - lekin wo dhurandhar title track ki tarah nahi hai ye thoda intense hai), 'destiny' (ye sunke to har baar wo fight yaad aati hai interval ke baad wali uske purane friend ke sath), 'aakhri ishq' (wo aakhri baar bolke jaata hai ki bas aaj kaam khatam karke aata hu phir yahan se kahin dur chale jayenge).
Is se achhi film koi kya hi banayega ab - log bolte the south ki filmein bollywood se jyada achhi ban rahi hai aaj kal, ya hollywood ki filmein best hoti hai - lekin bhai ye ek film hai jo 'pure' hindi bollywood film hai with all the 'heroic' moments (jab peeche dhamaka hota hai aur saamne hero chal ke jata hai type), aur iska muqabla koi aur bollywood film to kya koi hollywood ya south ki film bhi nahi kar sakti. Agar mai khud bhi ek bollywood ka director hota na to ye film dekhne ke baad mai khud apni dukaan band kar deta.

यह युद्ध केवल जमीन का नहीं, बल्कि वंश, डीएनए (DNA) और सांस्कृतिक पहचान को मिटाने का है। इसका केंद्र "नारी" है, क्योंकि नारी का जाना एक पूरी वंशावली का 'सांस्कृतिक संहार' है।
1. एकतरफा सेक्युलरिज्म बनाम मजहबी कट्टरता (The Hidden Truth):
सबसे बड़ा आत्मघाती कदम 'सेक्युलरिज्म' के नाम पर केवल हिन्दुओं को 'भाई-चारे' की अफीम चटाना है।

* मजहबी कूटनीति: दूसरे पक्ष (मुस्लिम) में बचपन से ही मस्जिद, मदरसे और परिवारों के भीतर यह ठोस 'प्रोग्रामिंग' की जाती है कि 'मोमिन' कौन है और 'काफिर' (दुश्मन) कौन है। उन्हें सिखाया जाता है कि काफिर की संपत्ति और उनकी स्त्रियां केवल 'गनीमत का माल' (War Booty) हैं। इसी कट्टर प्रशिक्षण के कारण उनकी बेटियां और लड़के अपनी मजहबी पहचान के प्रति 'लोहे' की तरह सख्त रहते हैं, जबकि हिन्दू बेटियां "सब धर्म समान हैं" के भ्रम में वैचारिक रूप से अपाहिज हो जाती हैं।

2. धर्म (Dharma) बनाम मजहब (Mazhab) का अंतर:
अपने बच्चों को यह अंतर साफ समझाएं:

* धर्म: यह 'मर्यादा' और 'कर्तव्य' है जो पूरी सृष्टि का कल्याण चाहता है। यह आपको 'मनुष्य' बनाता है।
* मजहब (Doctrine/Cult): यह एक 'किताब' और 'कानून' पर आधारित है जो अपनों को श्रेष्ठ और दूसरों (काफिरों) को नीचा या खत्म करने लायक समझता है। यह 'पहचान मिटाने' की राजनीति है।

3. 'एक्स-मुस्लिम' की गवाही: समाज के लिए चेतावनी:
सच्चाई को समझने के लिए Sahil, Zafar Heretic जैसे 'Ex-Muslims' के वीडियो अपनी बेटियों और बहनों को जरूर दिखाएं। ये वो लोग हैं जो उस सिस्टम की गहराई से बाहर आए हैं और वे सबूतों के साथ बताते हैं कि कैसे 'लव-जिहाद' एक संगठित मिशन है। इसमें 'फेक आईडी', 'मीठी बातें' और 'इमोशनल ब्लैकमेल' केवल हथियार हैं। जब तक लड़की का नाम, धर्म और उसके आने वाले बच्चों की पहचान न बदल दी जाए, तब तक यह जिहाद शांत नहीं होता।
4. फेक मॉडर्निज्म और 'मूर्ख' आइडियल (The Trap):
आज की लड़कियों के आइडियल सोशल मीडिया इन्फ्लुएंसर्स और फिल्म स्टार्स बन चुके हैं।

* अपमानजनक नज़रिया: वे आपकी लड़कियों को "बेअकल, मूर्ख और मर्यादा विहीन" समझते हैं। उन्हें लगता है कि हिन्दू लड़कियां 'लिबरल' और 'फेक फेमिनिज्म' के चक्कर में इतनी अंधी हो चुकी हैं कि उन्हें ज़रा से 'फेक मॉडर्निज्म' और 'लव-अफेयर' के लालच में खरीदा या फंसाया जा सकता है। आपकी बेटी का जाना उनके लिए 'रणनीतिक जीत' है।

5. इतिहास का शौर्य: स्वाभिमान का कवच:
बच्चों को रानी पद्मिनी का 'जौहर' और रानी लक्ष्मीबाई का 'शौर्य' याद दिलाएं। उन्हें छत्रपति शिवाजी, महाराणा प्रताप, हरि सिंह नलवा और बप्पा रावल की वीरता सिखाएं। उन्हें बताएं कि 'सतीत्व' और 'स्वाभिमान' के लिए हमारे पूर्वजों ने आग में जलना स्वीकार किया, लेकिन म्लेच्छों के सामने घुटने नहीं टेके।
------------------------------
हिन्दू परिवारों के लिए 'अस्तित्व रक्षा' का समाधान:

   1. दुश्मन की पहचान: बेटियों को बताएं कि जो 'प्यार' उनके धर्म और जड़ों को मिटाने की शर्त रखे, वह 'जिहाद' है।
   2. असली आधुनिकता: आधुनिकता 'विचारों' में होती है, कपड़ों के 'छोटा' होने में नहीं। शालीनता ही असली 'पावर' है।
   3. शास्त्र और शस्त्र: हर हिन्दू घर में भगवद्गीता की तार्किक शिक्षा और बेटियों के लिए आत्मरक्षा (Combat Training) अनिवार्य हो।
   4. मर्यादा का स्वाभिमान: समाज को गंदा होने से बचाने के लिए 'मर्यादा' को अपना सबसे बड़ा गहना बनाएं।

अंतिम निष्कर्ष: यह युद्ध "अस्तित्व बनाम सर्वनाश" का है। यदि हिन्दू माता-पिता अपनी बेटियों को 'ज्ञान' और 'स्वाभिमान' का कवच नहीं देंगे, तो वे 'फेक सेक्युलरिज्म' के नाम पर "मूर्ख" समझकर शिकार होती रहेंगी। नारी की मर्यादा ही धर्म की अंतिम दीवार है।
क्या आप इस अंतिम सत्य को अपने समाज के हर द्वार तक पहुँचाने का संकल्प लेते हैं? 2:49

यह युद्ध केवल जमीन का नहीं, बल्कि वंश, डीएनए (DNA) और सांस्कृतिक पहचान को मिटाने का है। इसका केंद्र "नारी" है, क्योंकि नारी का जाना एक पूरी वंशावली का 'सांस्कृतिक संहार' है।
1. एकतरफा सेक्युलरिज्म बनाम मजहबी कट्टरता (The Hidden Truth):
सबसे बड़ा आत्मघाती कदम 'सेक्युलरिज्म' के नाम पर केवल हिन्दुओं को 'भाई-चारे' की अफीम चटाना है।

* मजहबी कूटनीति: दूसरे पक्ष (मुस्लिम) में बचपन से ही मस्जिद, मदरसे और परिवारों के भीतर यह ठोस 'प्रोग्रामिंग' की जाती है कि 'मोमिन' कौन है और 'काफिर' (दुश्मन) कौन है। उन्हें सिखाया जाता है कि काफिर की संपत्ति और उनकी स्त्रियां केवल 'गनीमत का माल' (War Booty) हैं। इसी कट्टर प्रशिक्षण के कारण उनकी बेटियां और लड़के अपनी मजहबी पहचान के प्रति 'लोहे' की तरह सख्त रहते हैं, जबकि हिन्दू बेटियां "सब धर्म समान हैं" के भ्रम में वैचारिक रूप से अपाहिज हो जाती हैं।

2. धर्म (Dharma) बनाम मजहब (Mazhab) का अंतर:
अपने बच्चों को यह अंतर साफ समझाएं:

* धर्म: यह 'मर्यादा' और 'कर्तव्य' है जो पूरी सृष्टि का कल्याण चाहता है। यह आपको 'मनुष्य' बनाता है।
* मजहब (Doctrine/Cult): यह एक 'किताब' और 'कानून' पर आधारित है जो अपनों को श्रेष्ठ और दूसरों (काफिरों) को नीचा या खत्म करने लायक समझता है। यह 'पहचान मिटाने' की राजनीति है।

3. 'एक्स-मुस्लिम' की गवाही: समाज के लिए चेतावनी:
सच्चाई को समझने के लिए Sahil, Zafar Heretic जैसे 'Ex-Muslims' के वीडियो अपनी बेटियों और बहनों को जरूर दिखाएं। ये वो लोग हैं जो उस सिस्टम की गहराई से बाहर आए हैं और वे सबूतों के साथ बताते हैं कि कैसे 'लव-जिहाद' एक संगठित मिशन है। इसमें 'फेक आईडी', 'मीठी बातें' और 'इमोशनल ब्लैकमेल' केवल हथियार हैं। जब तक लड़की का नाम, धर्म और उसके आने वाले बच्चों की पहचान न बदल दी जाए, तब तक यह जिहाद शांत नहीं होता।
4. फेक मॉडर्निज्म और 'मूर्ख' आइडियल (The Trap):
आज की लड़कियों के आइडियल सोशल मीडिया इन्फ्लुएंसर्स और फिल्म स्टार्स बन चुके हैं।

* अपमानजनक नज़रिया: वे आपकी लड़कियों को "बेअकल, मूर्ख और मर्यादा विहीन" समझते हैं। उन्हें लगता है कि हिन्दू लड़कियां 'लिबरल' और 'फेक फेमिनिज्म' के चक्कर में इतनी अंधी हो चुकी हैं कि उन्हें ज़रा से 'फेक मॉडर्निज्म' और 'लव-अफेयर' के लालच में खरीदा या फंसाया जा सकता है। आपकी बेटी का जाना उनके लिए 'रणनीतिक जीत' है।

5. इतिहास का शौर्य: स्वाभिमान का कवच:
बच्चों को रानी पद्मिनी का 'जौहर' और रानी लक्ष्मीबाई का 'शौर्य' याद दिलाएं। उन्हें छत्रपति शिवाजी, महाराणा प्रताप, हरि सिंह नलवा और बप्पा रावल की वीरता सिखाएं। उन्हें बताएं कि 'सतीत्व' और 'स्वाभिमान' के लिए हमारे पूर्वजों ने आग में जलना स्वीकार किया, लेकिन म्लेच्छों के सामने घुटने नहीं टेके।
------------------------------
हिन्दू परिवारों के लिए 'अस्तित्व रक्षा' का समाधान:

   1. दुश्मन की पहचान: बेटियों को बताएं कि जो 'प्यार' उनके धर्म और जड़ों को मिटाने की शर्त रखे, वह 'जिहाद' है।
   2. असली आधुनिकता: आधुनिकता 'विचारों' में होती है, कपड़ों के 'छोटा' होने में नहीं। शालीनता ही असली 'पावर' है।
   3. शास्त्र और शस्त्र: हर हिन्दू घर में भगवद्गीता की तार्किक शिक्षा और बेटियों के लिए आत्मरक्षा (Combat Training) अनिवार्य हो।
   4. मर्यादा का स्वाभिमान: समाज को गंदा होने से बचाने के लिए 'मर्यादा' को अपना सबसे बड़ा गहना बनाएं।

अंतिम निष्कर्ष: यह युद्ध "अस्तित्व बनाम सर्वनाश" का है। यदि हिन्दू माता-पिता अपनी बेटियों को 'ज्ञान' और 'स्वाभिमान' का कवच नहीं देंगे, तो वे 'फेक सेक्युलरिज्म' के नाम पर "मूर्ख" समझकर शिकार होती रहेंगी। नारी की मर्यादा ही धर्म की अंतिम दीवार है।
क्या आप इस अंतिम सत्य को अपने समाज के हर द्वार तक पहुँचाने का संकल्प लेते हैं?

AI-Generated Imagery: Director Aditya Dhar confirmed that a widely circulated image showing Ranveer Singh’s character smoking while wearing a turban is a "fake" and "AI-generated" image not part of the film.

Exaggerated Fake Currency Figures: The film claims a ₹71,000 crore fake note injection, a figure critics argue is a cinematic exaggeration to justify demonetization.

Fabricated "Pro-Terror" Political Narratives: Critics argue the film invents scenes suggesting specific Indian political leaders were complicit with terror groups, termed as a distortion of facts.

Rehman Dakait as a "Chill Guy": The portrayal of notorious Pakistani criminal Rehman Dakait, acted by Akshaye Khanna, as a charming, "chill" character is seen as a glorification of a criminal rather than a factual representation.

Biased Portrayal of Past Governments: The film is criticized for distorting the response of previous Indian governments to terror attacks, allegedly to serve a "propaganda" narrative.

"Half-Brother" Pakistan Narrative: Critics argue that the movie focuses on sensationalist anti-Pakistan narratives rather than complex geopolitical realities.

Inaccuracy in 26/11 Footage: The film blends real footage of the 26/11 attacks with fabricated storylines.

Dramatic 4-Hour Narrative: The overall length and dramatization, which includes intense, unrealistic "blood baths" and "non-stop explosions," is viewed as a cinematic, non-factual exaggeration of events.

Fabricated Intelligence Agent Behavior: The film portrays intelligence agents acting outside established legal norms, which critics claim is an insult to real patriotic officers.

The "2026 Revenge" Premise: The entire premise of the "Dhurandhar 2" plot is criticized as a propagandist, non-factual representation of India-Pakistan spy games.

After my first watch, I kept wondering what happened to Altaf Khanani as he didn't appear in the Revenge. On my second watch, I noticed that Hamza actually asks/confirms about Altaf's whereabouts with his brother Javed Khanani when they are on the roof before he k1lls him. Hamza says something along the lines of "So your brother has been captured in the USA and asked to serve 25 years in prison. And Javed says, "Ha Hamza, sab taraf se buri waqt chal rahi hai." 
I didn't catch this bit in my first watch and I kept trying to Google what happened, but there was no info anywhere. Thank God I caught it the second time. 😅😅 Phew 😪

snippet.textDisplay: Has anyone noticed? When Major Iqbal's dad Brigadier Jahangir is introduced, they show two Macaws, yellow and red. They are supposed to represent Major Iqbal and his father. In the first scene, you see the yellow one constantly pecking at the red one, and the red one taking the attacks from the yellow one. It indicates how Major Iqbal constantly tolerates his father's insults. In the end scene, where Major Iqbal takes his dad's life, they then span the camera to where the birds are in the cage and you see only the red one. The yellow one disappears, meaning that Brigadier Jahangir is unalived by Major Iqbal. Peak detailing by Aditya Dhar. 👌🏻👌🏻

snippet.textDisplay:
What is the reality of the movie Dhurandhar? If you look at Bollywood's track record, films made against Pakistan have always been hits, but the truth behind these movies never comes out because they are based on false stories. Just look at Dhurandhar—it portrays the Pakistani military as incredibly bloodthirsty and cruel, while the public is shown as innocent victims being constantly killed by them.
​I don't understand the movie's concept. If Dhurandhar's father-in-law, who was sent 45 years ago, is also an Indian agent—and he was the one who almost had Rehman Dakait killed by SP Aslam in Dhurandhar Part 1—then why did Dhurandhar himself even need to come to Pakistan? Even the biggest mastermind, 'Bade Sahab,' is poisoned by the father-in-law. So, what was Dhurandhar's purpose for coming to Pakistan?
​According to the film, most of the terrorism is centered in Karachi, even though Karachi was already being cleaned up. Such nonsense! Honestly😂

snippet.textDisplay:
Thank you, Team Dhurandar  especially Aditya Dhar, Singh, and Shashwat  for this wonderful journey of D1 & D2.
I’ve never been this excited for any movie, ever. But the success of D1 & D2 feels so personal to me — I don’t even know why. I’m a huge fan of cinema. I watched D1 three times in the theatre, and I’m definitely going to watch D2 three times as well.
But honestly, the acting by all the characters especially Singh was beyond words. And Shashwat’s music was truly the backbone of the movie and the mastermind behind it all, Aditya Dhar sir… no words for you. You are a once-in-a-generation director for India. Your positivity, attention to detail, direction, and writing everything was absolutely on point.
I’ve never enjoyed any movie like this before.

Thanks again ❤🔥🗿

snippet.textDisplay: Some are saying this is a true patriotic film, some a saying this is a propaganda film. Lets stick to the fact that this is a film and watch this as a film as a documentary, because both parts are almost 4 hours in duration. Lets understand what pakistan as a nation is thinking about us they have a state called "Balochistan" from where Akshaye Khanna's character is belonging ,Insteresting facts about balochistan is In 1761 Panipat war, when Ahmed Shah Abdali was returning to Kandahar, he took Maharashtrian peoples and warriors with who were found alive after the war. The reason for this was prior to the war coming to India he took Soldiers and peoples as help from the King of Balochistan Meer Khan, they all died and to return the king Abdali had nothing. So he returned marathi peoples and warriors to the Balochistan King. After a period of time he converted this peoples to Islam, still this marathi peoples did'nt forget their culture their tradition. They later came to known as Bugti Marathe, Saahu Marathe (Mazaari a surname of this people which is used by Ranveer character) who did continued their agricultural practice in balochistan by themselves finding and making good water resources. They were turned Islamist but their tradition was still Maharashtrian even today and they did'nt hesitate to pratice that tradition , which is not accepted by other pakistanis, due to which this Baloch peoples got betrayed by Mohammad Ali Jinnah after partition in 1947.  So from that time Indian Government is helping and is having empathy for this people , not because they can give India political benifits , but because  THESE PEOPLES BELONGING TO THE INDIAN SOIL ,THOUGH THEY ARE CONVERTED TO ISLAM THEY ARE OUR PEOPLES. EVEN THOUGH BEING IN ANOTHER NATION 200 YEARS PRIOR TO PARTITION THEY ARE STILL NOT BEING TREATED WITH HUMANITY, THAT'S THE REASON WHY INDIA IS SUPPORTING THEM. JAI HIND🇮🇳

snippet.textDisplay:
Dhurandhar 2 is cinema at its best. It delivers on every front-scale, drama, emotions, action, performances, and impact. Take a bow, Aditya Dhar-this is a sure-shot epic blockbuster.

The expectations for the sequel to Dhurandhar were naturally sky-high. Thankfully, Dhurandhar: The Revenge not only meets those mammoth expectations but surpasses them by leaps and bounds.

Director Aditya Dhar returns with a vision that is bigger, sharper, and far more ambitious. While the first part laid the foundation, Dhurandhar: The Revenge elevates the narrative to an entirely new level.

The performances are top-notch across the board. Ranveer Singh delivers a towering act, portraying strength, intensity, and vulnerability with equal finesse. He is the backbone, the soul, and the lifeline of the sequel-easily the best performance of his career.

The duology-Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar: The Revenge-will undoubtedly go down as landmark milestones in his career. Now for the big question: Who is Bade Saab? Get ready to be shocked. Also, a powerful actress makes a striking cameo appearance

What truly makes the film stand out is its emotional core. Beneath the spectacle lies a powerful story of courage, resilience, revenge, and justice-elements that linger long after the screening ends.

The screenplay is the film's backbone-tightly written, fast-paced, and loaded with goosebumps-inducing moments. Just when you feel the film has reached its peak, it raises the bar yet again.

The climax deserves special mention-explosive, emotional, and immensely satisfying. In fact, the final moments will leave you speechless; that is the kind of impact the film has when you exit the auditorium.

The dialogues deserve special mention too: punchy, powerful, and perfectly designed to evoke whistles and thunderous applause. The action sequences are staged with tremendous style and scale. The background score elevates the drama significantly, while the cinematography captures the film's grand canvas with striking visuals. Special mention must also be made of the razor-sharp editing, which ensures the film never loses momentum.

In short, if you loved the first part, you are going to adore the second installment. Aditya Dhar once again proves that he is a magician, delivering a sequel that not only matches the impact of the first part but elevates the experience to an even higher level. 
Final Verdict: A Rare Sequel That Outshines the Original in Every Way

snippet.textDisplay:
If a film shows a Prime Minister becoming a headache for terror groups, a chaiwala rising and challenging terrorism, and that chaiwala happens to be the PM of India, then the film is clearly pro-India and anti-terrorism. Don't rush to label it pro-BJP. If you still call it pro-BJP despite that, then you are indirectly saying that being pro-India is the same as being pro-BJP.

Now, the question is, people are saying that the film has shown the previous government in a bad light, so here is the point.

Shiv Shankar Menon, the former NSA of India, has written in his book that there was a clear plan from the army after 26/11, but the Congress government back then stopped the army from executing this plan.

Even Barack Obama, in his autobiography (A Promised Land), has written that during a conversation with Manmohan Singh, he said that he avoided retaliation against Pakistan after 26/11 because he didn't want to create communal stress in India. Really? How would attacking Pakistan have brought communal tension in India?

Now tell me, why should Dhurandhar 2 not show the previous government as incompetent and traitorous?
